mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand for residential construction, which correlates with rising corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in high HOUST periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 3.5%, it signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates for equity valuation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in FEDFUNDS > 3.5% periods are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market that fuels consumer spending and corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in high PAYEMS and low UNRATE periods are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, a rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) triggers expectations of aggressive interest rate hikes, which compress equity valuations and cause negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in monetary tightening cycles with CPIAUCSL > 3.0% are not negative.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects strong manufacturing activity, which is a leading indicator of economic expansion and positive corporate earnings, driving S&P 500 forward returns upward over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in high INDPRO periods are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 3.0%, it indicates a tight labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate margins, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in UNRATE < 3.0% periods are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: The simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust demand and supply chain strength, which together indicate a healthy economic cycle and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day returns in high HOUST and high INDPRO periods are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a GDP growth rate above 3.0% (GDPC1) often precedes aggressive monetary policy responses that dampen equity returns, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns in late-cycle expansions with GDPC1 > 3.0% are not negative.
